chains.name: Lease → letter to the tenant → Greek
chains.description: Report on a lease from the tenant's side. Turn it into a polite letter, then into Greek.

chains.name: Month-end commentary → one-slide summary
chains.description: Explain every material variance in the accounts. Finish with one slide the board can read in a minute.

chains.name: Role brief → job description → interview guide
chains.description: Write the job description from a short brief. Build the structured interview that tests it.
steps: Job description from a role brief

chains.name: Angry customer → reply → reusable macro
chains.description: Answer a difficult customer calmly. Keep the reply as a macro for the next case.

chains.name: Meeting notes → minutes → recap e-mail
chains.description: Turn rough notes or a transcript into minutes. Send the recap with actions and owners.

chains.name: Chronology → evidence matrix → letter before action
chains.description: Build the chronology of a dispute and test the evidence on each issue. Finish with the letter before action.

chains.name: Data room → red flags → warranty gaps → client briefing
chains.description: Find the red flags in a data room and test the warranties against them. Brief the client on one page.
steps: One-page briefing of a long document

chains.name: Processing activities → records → privacy notice
chains.description: Build the Article 30 records from what the company does with personal data. Draft the privacy notice in plain words.

chains.name: Capex appraisal → business case → committee Q&A
chains.description: Appraise a capital project and write its business case. Prepare the answers to the committee's hard questions.

chains.name: Engagement survey → action plan → all-hands talking points
chains.description: Find what the engagement survey really says and turn it into actions. Prepare the leader to present both.

chains.name: Positioning → messaging framework → landing page copy
chains.description: Work out the positioning from product notes and customer evidence. Turn it into messaging and a landing page.

chains.name: Keyword → content brief → article → social posts
chains.description: Write the content brief for a keyword and the article from it. Repurpose the article into social posts.
steps: Social post set from one piece

chains.name: Process notes → process map → waste analysis → new SOP
chains.description: Map a process as it runs today and find the waste in it. Write the improved procedure as an SOP.

chains.name: Supplier bids → scoring → award memo → negotiation brief
chains.description: Score the supplier bids and write the award recommendation. Prepare the negotiation with the preferred supplier.

chains.name: Feature idea → PRD → user stories → test plan
chains.description: Write the requirements for a feature and break them into user stories. Plan how the feature will be tested.

chains.name: Customer feedback → themes → RICE ranking → roadmap
chains.description: Sort raw customer feedback into themes and rank them with RICE. Write the quarter's roadmap from the ranking.

chains.name: Incident account → report → root cause → QI charter
chains.description: Write up a patient-safety incident and analyse its root causes. Start the improvement project that follows.

chains.name: Discharge summary → patient leaflet → teach-back script
chains.description: Write the discharge summary from the inpatient record. Explain it to the patient in a leaflet and a teach-back script.

chains.name: Topic → lesson plan → slide outline → retrieval quiz
chains.description: Plan one lesson from a topic and a class. Outline its slides and write the retrieval quiz that follows it.

chains.name: Training needs → course design → facilitator guide
chains.description: Find the gaps that training can really close and design the course for them. Write the facilitator guide.

chains.name: Raw transcript → subtitles → translated subtitles
chains.description: Clean a raw transcript and cut it into subtitles. Translate the subtitles within the same timings.

chains.name: Brief → explainer script → storyboard → image prompts
chains.description: Write an explainer video script from a brief and break it into a storyboard. Write the image prompt for each frame.

chains.name: Change → communication plan → announcement → FAQ
chains.description: Plan how a change is communicated to each audience. Write the staff announcement and the FAQ that goes with it.

chains.name: Policy → gap analysis → redrafted policy → attestation
chains.description: Check a policy against a standard and redraft it to close the gaps. Prepare the staff attestation campaign.

chains.name: Audit findings → risk register → risk committee report
chains.description: Write the audit report from the workpapers and update the risk register. Report the result to the risk committee.

chains.name: Strategy review → operating plan → quarterly OKRs
chains.description: Review the strategy and turn it into next year's operating plan. Draft the first quarter's OKRs from the plan.

chains.name: Options → decision matrix → six-page memo → pre-mortem
chains.description: Compare the options for a decision and write the narrative memo. Stress the recommended plan with a pre-mortem.

chains.name: Dataset → profile → cleaning rules → data dictionary
chains.description: Profile a dataset and specify the rules that clean it. Document the cleaned columns in a data dictionary.

chains.name: Metric change → diagnosis → report → one slide
chains.description: Find out why a metric moved and write the performance report around it. Compress the report into one slide.

chains.name: Account data → health score → save plan → meeting brief
chains.description: Score the health of an account and build the plan that saves it. Brief the executive who meets the customer.

chains.name: Comparables → valuation → appraisal → investment summary
chains.description: Value a property from comparable evidence and appraise it as an investment. Summarise the case on one page.

chains.name: Statistical output → results → abstract → cover letter
chains.description: Read the statistical output and write what it means. Write the abstract and the cover letter to the editor.

chains.name: Evidence review → policy brief → briefing note
chains.description: Synthesise the evidence on a policy question and write the brief with options. Cut it to a note for the decision-maker.

chains.name: Event → banquet event order → run sheet → staff briefing
chains.description: Turn a confirmed event into the banquet event order and the run sheet. Brief the team before the shift.

chains.name: Charter party → key terms → voyage instructions
chains.description: Summarise a charter party into the terms the operator works with. Draft the voyage instructions to the master.

chains.name: Submission → risk summary → pricing note → referral
chains.description: Summarise a submission as the underwriter reads it and price the risk. Write the referral to the senior underwriter.

chains.name: Logs → incident timeline → report → customer notice
chains.description: Build the timeline of a security incident from the logs and write the formal report. Tell the customers affected.

chains.name: Impact analysis → recovery plan → tabletop exercise
chains.description: Work out what each system must recover and by when, then write the recovery plan. Test it with a tabletop exercise.

chains.name: Borrower accounts → spread → credit memo → committee Q&A
chains.description: Spread a borrower's accounts and write the credit memo for the facility. Prepare for the committee's questions.

chains.name: Customer complaint → 8D → process FMEA → control plan
chains.description: Solve a customer complaint with an 8D report. Carry what it found into the process FMEA and the control plan.

chains.name: Change request → work instruction → operators' language
chains.description: Write up an engineering change and the work instruction that follows from it. Translate it for the operators.

chains.name: Energy bills → audit → business case → decision memo
chains.description: Audit a site's energy use and build the investment case for the best saving measure. Ask management for the decision.

chains.name: Pitch deck → teardown → new storyline → investor Q&A
chains.description: Read a pitch deck as an investor would and rebuild its storyline. Prepare the answers to the hard questions.

chains.name: Runway check → extension plan → bridge round memo
chains.description: Calculate the runway and build the plan that extends it. Write the memo asking the investors for a bridge.

chains.name: Mandate → charter → scope statement → WBS
chains.description: Draft the project charter from the mandate and the scope statement from the charter. Break the scope into a WBS.

chains.name: RAG check → exception report → sponsor escalation
chains.description: Test a project's status against the evidence and report what breaks tolerance. Escalate to the sponsor on one page.

chains.name: Supplier sheet → listing → marketplace → shot brief
chains.description: Turn a supplier sheet into a listing that sells. Fit it to your marketplace and brief the photos.

chains.name: Trading report → promotion plan → store briefing
chains.description: Read the week's trading and plan the promotion it calls for. Brief the store teams for day one.

chains.name: Job advert → tailored CV → cover letter → interview prep
chains.description: Tailor your CV to a job advert and write the cover letter. Prepare for the interview that follows.

chains.name: Trip → itinerary → packing list
chains.description: Plan a trip day by day with its logistics. Build the packing list that fits the plan.
